title: Argentinian Kissed Bean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Argentina, made with tender beans, kissed beef, and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: kissed beef
ingredients.notes: preferably slow-cooked with garlic and thyme

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add kissed beef; cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes; cook for 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste; cook for 1 minute.
Add stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Add kidney beans; simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
